title: HIL Run Log
description: One episode. v1.1 adds properties (v1.0 declared `required` with no `properties`, so nothing but key presence was validated), a graded item score, an explicit failure mode, and the response digest the concordance audit needs.

delivered.description: The harness handed the work back as finished.

verifier_pass.description: The external verifier's verdict. Recorded whether or not the work was delivered, so false rejection is observable.

harness_accepted.description: The acceptance step's decision, distinct from the verifier verdict. Required from v1.0 onward because a success-only aggregate is exactly invariant to acceptance (framework Prop. 1).

item_score.description: Graded outcome in [0,1] where the item supports one. Null for pass/fail items. `verifier_pass` remains the gate; this carries how much was right, because 'eight rules of ten' and 'produced nothing' are different states with different next actions.

failure_mode.description: Why it failed, when that is separable. These need different repairs; a single failed bucket reports an executor that misread the task and one that implemented a near-optimal heuristic identically.

response_digest.description: Stable digest of the executor's answer. The concordance audit needs only this and the correctness flag -- never the key.

executor_tier.description: Capability tier label. The concordance audit is meaningful only across tiers.

paired_with.description: run_id of the rung scored from the same executor artifact. Required when two rungs differ only in post-hoc machinery.

then.description: A graded item that scored 1.0 must have passed, and one that passed must not be graded below 1.0. The two fields must not tell different stories.
